desc: Implement a trie (arrays/dicts) inserting all words, recording per-node counts and node ids at each depth.
Compute for each depth d the max count (with node id) and second max count.
For each word i, walk its path; answer[i] = deepest depth d where adjusted count (best-1 if best node is on path, else best; fall back to second-best when best node is on path) >= k.
Handle edge cases: n - 1 < k yields all zeros; verify k == 1 works (deepest node with count >= 1 after removal).
Validate against both provided examples plus custom tests (duplicate words, words that are prefixes of others, k = n, single-character words).
Write final solution in starter code with imports; confirm O(total characters) complexity.
Fix gap: consider depths beyond len(words[i]) via suffix max of valid depths (counts unchanged there); verified with ["a","abc","abd"], k=2 case.
